title: MELLA: Bridging Linguistic Capability and Cultural Groundedness for Low-Resource Language MLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's cultural groundedness by measuring keyword accuracy (using TF-IDF) on a dataset curated from native web alt-texts to test its ability to identify culturally specific entities, such as local celebrities and traditional items.

Measuring linguistic capability and fluency across eight low-resource languages using standard text generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR) on translated image descriptions to evaluate the disparity between high-resource and low-resource language performance.
